recipe.visualDefinition: A surreal interior scene featuring a man levitating horizontally against a textured ceiling, while other figures occupy a dark, moody room below. The composition uses a high-contrast palette of deep teal, emerald green, and pops of magenta, creating a dreamlike, gravity-defying narrative.
coreVisualRelationships: The levitating figure acts as a horizontal counter-balance to the vertical architectural lines.
The dark teal walls provide a high-value contrast for the brightly colored furniture and clothing.
The mirrored text orientation reflects the 'upside-down' theme of the levitating subject.
coreInvariants: Levitating figure in a magenta top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is positioned in the upper third, spanning horizontally. Secondary figures are distributed in the lower two-thirds to create depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright magenta shirt of the levitating man serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the levitating figure, moves down to the man on the sofa, across to the figure in the foreground looking up, and finally to the doorway.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large expanses of dark teal wall create a sense of isolation and focus on the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep teal/dark blue-green walls and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Emerald green sofa and magenta/pink clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm white lamps and light-colored ceiling tiles.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in specific objects against a low-value, desaturated background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The secondary line is vertically mirrored (flipped upside down) to reflect the surreal theme.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with color and orientation contrast.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rule separating the two lines of text.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic geometric sans-serif with clean lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal interior with dark teal walls, an emerald green sofa, and a man in a magenta shirt levitating against a grid-tiled ceiling. Include a man looking up from the bottom right and another figure in a doorway.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of bold sans-serif text in the top right. The top line is white and right-aligned. The bottom line is magenta, right-aligned, and vertically mirrored (upside down), separated by a thin white line.

verificationChecks: Is the secondary text line mirrored?
Is the wall color a deep, moody teal?

mustRedesign: Original band name and album title
The specific painting on the wall
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the levitating man looks physically integrated with the ceiling.
Check that the mirrored text is legible but clearly inverted.
Verify the emerald green of the sofa is vibrant against the teal walls.
Confirm the lighting source (lamps) creates realistic shadows.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a surreal physical feat (levitation) with a moody, high-contrast interior and a typographic treatment that mirrors the visual inversion.
